verdict.rationale: BigQuery ships AI features such as Gemini assistance and conversational data agents, so a buyer could fairly ask whether those agents can consume external MCP tools. The axis therefore applies. However, the evidence never documents any way to register or connect external MCP servers to BigQuery. MCP Toolbox for Databases is an MCP server that exposes databases to other agents, which is the opposite (server) role, so it earns no credit for this client-side story.
